name: Spotify for Podcasters
tagline: Spotify for Podcasters (now part of Spotify's creator tools) provides free podcast hosting, distribution, and analytics alongside AI-powered features like automatic transcripts, clip suggestions, and audience Q&A. Podcasters publish to Spotify's 600-million-user platform directly and monetise through Spotify's subscription and ad programs. It's the largest podcast platform globally and the most straightforward path to a broad audience.
